title: Liquid Vox Stutter
description: One pitched 'east' hit mangled into a chopped, vocal-ish garage hook: chop(16) grains stutter through stepped speed (reverse and half-speed) for a granular cloud, while vowel formants and a crush/filter morph make it liquid. Pitch, timbre, vowel, and chop density all shift across a 16-cycle arc, tailing into room plus dotted delay.
code:
setcpm(132/4)
stack(
  s("east*2")
    .chop("<16 16 24 16 12 16 32 16>/2")
    .speed("<1 -1 0.5 1 -1 2 0.5 -0.5>/2")
    .n("<0 1 0 2>")
    .vowel("<a e i o u e a o>/2")
    .crush(perlin.range(5, 12).slow(13))
    .lpf(sine.range(500, 4200).slow(11))
    .resonance(sine.range(6, 16).slow(7))
    .pan(sine.range(0.15, 0.85).slow(23))
    .sometimesBy(0.2, x => x.speed(-1).chop(32))
    .every(8, x => x.rev())
    .gain(0.9)
    .shape(0.3)
    .room(sine.range(0.25, 0.6).slow(29))
    .delay("0.45:0.1875:0.55")
    .orbit(1)
)
